hooks.name: constants-sync-on-engine-save
hooks.description: When the shared constants or the Python engine are saved, run the constants sync test.

action.command: mkdir -p docs/kiro_evidence/raw && echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) hook fired: constants or engine saved" >> docs/kiro_evidence/raw/hook_runs.log ; python3 -B scripts/test_constants_sync.py >> docs/kiro_evidence/raw/hook_runs.log 2>&1 ; true
